description: Interrupciones programadas del servicio de acueducto – EPM is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by E.S.P. Empresas Públicas de Medellín - EPM, Antioquia. Este conjunto de datos muestra las interrupciones programadas del servicio de acueducto realizadas por EPM entre los años 2019 y 2026. La información está organizada por semanas e incluye registros desde la semana 1 de 2019 hasta la semana 25 de 2026, con algunas variaciones según el año. Coverage: Colombia. The portal files it under the publisher E.S.P. Empresas Públicas de Medellín - EPM, Antioquia. Its tags are horarios, servicios, interrupciones, epm., clientes. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Planeación. The portal shows 2026-05-11 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
